action_items: VERIFY during a live session: SpellTracker visibility on character sheet requires canEditMech=true — make sure owner/GM check resolves promptly on slow networks (same race-risk pattern as iter_49 Convert button).

VERIFY SessionView route: direct navigation to /app/campaigns/{cid}/session redirects to landing. If that's an intentional gate (no active session), consider a friendlier '/no active session' state rather than a silent redirect to / which can look like a logout.

Review request listed outdated character IDs for D&D Eli (733ff0dc…) and Cypher Eli (3c37c7ab…); the live DB has 2c68ff49f249418b8ff2effef20ef1fc (D&D) and 48e2358e167e4261a59130d4c759ccf9 (Cypher). Update /app/memory or seed scripts so next iteration gets correct IDs.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/advancement.py is 684 lines — still under 700, but close. Splitting into advancement_detect.py + spell_tracker.py + seed_admin.py would improve maintainability.
_build_spell_tracker_state and _detect_advancement are pure helpers — good test surface (11 unit tests cover them). Keep as pure functions.
AdvancementApplyIn.advancement_id uses string prefix matching (asi-/subclass-/cypher-tier-) — works but brittle. Consider an enum kind + lvl fields in the payload for forward-compat with new systems.
seed-anime5e-reference uses system_id check 'anime-5e' only — if other systems ever want seed templates, generalise to accept a seed registry key.

Frontend AdvancementWizard modal's data-testid can be overridden via `testid` prop; my test query '[data-testid=advancement-modal]' didn't match — consistent fallback naming or export a constant would help.
